en.title: FAA clears Skyways to test offshore drone deliveries for Shell
en.summary: The FAA has authorized Skyways to fly a cargo drone from Gibson, Louisiana, to a Shell platform in the Gulf of Mexico for a pipeline inspection and simulated equipment delivery — the first US authorization for a drone to fly from the coast out over the Gulf beyond its operator's visual line of sight.
body: The FAA has authorized Skyways, an Austin, Texas-based cargo drone manufacturer and operator, to fly from Gibson, Louisiana, to a Shell platform in the Gulf of Mexico for a pipeline inspection and simulated equipment delivery. On the planned demonstration flight, the aircraft will inspect a pipeline right-of-way en route to the platform and simulate a delivery of equipment when it arrives.

The FAA announced the waiver allowing the flight on November 9, 2026, describing it as the first US authorization for a drone to fly from the coast out over the Gulf beyond its operator's visual line of sight. The FAA granted the waiver under Section 927 of the FAA Reauthorization Act of 2024. That provision gives the agency a way to authorize specific drone operations that fall outside existing rules.

Skyways will launch its V2 aircraft from Shell Pipeline Company's facility on the Gulf Coast. The V2 uses electric motors for vertical takeoff and landing, then switches to a heavy-fuel engine for cruise. A satellite link provides command and control offshore. Shell Pipeline Company already uses drones offshore and has worked with Skyways on pipeline inspections in the Gulf. The demonstration combines that inspection work with a test of the aircraft's cargo role. Skyways said it hopes to use the V2 for more frequent inspections and eventually carry cargo to offshore installations for a fee.

zh.title: FAA放行Skyways無人機為殼牌測試離岸運補
zh.summary: 美國聯邦航空總署已授權Skyways以無人機自路易斯安那州吉布森飛往墨西哥灣殼牌平台，執行管線檢查與模擬設備運送；這是美國首次授權無人機自海岸飛往灣區、超出操作者視距的飛行。
body: 美國聯邦航空總署已授權總部位於德州奧斯汀的貨運無人機製造商與營運商Skyways，自路易斯安那州吉布森飛往墨西哥灣一座殼牌平台，執行管線檢查與模擬設備運送。計畫中的展示飛行將在前往平台途中檢查管線通行權，抵達後模擬運送設備。
聯邦航空總署於11月9日宣布這項豁免，稱其為美國首次授權無人機自海岸飛往灣區、超出操作者視距的飛行。豁免依據《2024年聯邦航空總署再授權法》第927條，該條款讓主管機關得以授權現行規則之外的特定無人機作業。
Skyways將自殼牌管線公司位於灣岸的設施起飛V2飛機；V2以電動馬達垂直起降，再切換至重油發動機巡航，衛星鏈路在離岸提供指揮與控制。殼牌管線公司已在離岸使用無人機，並與Skyways合作進行灣區管線檢查；這次展示結合既有檢查工作與飛機貨運角色的測試。Skyways表示希望以V2進行更頻繁的檢查，最終以收費方式向離岸設施運送貨物。
